name: JSF monolith migration to React + Quarkus

mentions.name: JSF monolith migration to React + Quarkus
mentions.description: A legacy application modernization project that ports a giant monolithic JSF app from JSF/Wildfly into two separate apps: a React frontend and a REST Quarkus backend. The work is being done with the help of AI agents, with the goal of helping the long-standing legacy application scale and improve for its many users.
mentions.problem: The existing legacy JSF monolith is difficult to scale and improve, and many people currently depend on it.
mentions.source_excerpt: Porting a giant monolithic JSF app from JSF/Wildfly to two separate apps, a react frontend and a REST Quarkus backend.
